chronology_note: r133 extends Phase-1 r132 with a two-entity atomic-root/orphan-recovery interruption probe. Two immutable object events plus a candidate root were created without advancing the publication HEAD; fresh reconstruction followed HEAD and stayed at A=10/B=20, proving the unpublished candidate was non-authoritative. The same op_id then reused the deterministic candidate root and advanced HEAD once to A=7/B=23; a stale writer was rejected with HTTP 409. A separate unique-path create also transiently hit 409 when repository main advanced concurrently and then succeeded on deterministic retry, so the protocol now explicitly requires idempotent content paths plus retry/reconstruction. Overall parity remains unresolved; next leaf is a rate-limit-safe retry state machine, then effect-class parity mapping.
